_comment: How an all-caps or all-lowercase event title or venue is changed to title case (ConvertTo-WkTitleCase in ingestion/scripts/lib/Schema.ps1). A word in keepUpper stays capitalized, and so does a word with no vowels (DJ, CSL, BBQ) or a Roman numeral. forms gives a word's exact spelling. smallWords are lowercase except at the start or after a colon. A city adds words in its own data/schema/title-case.json. Words are matched in uppercase. All-lowercase text skips keepUpper.
